summary: Tested Calendar feature. Backend API (10/10 tests passed): all CRUD operations working. Frontend: Calendar page loads at /calendar BUT uses MeetingCalendarPage (simpler UI with local storage) instead of CalendarPage (Month/Week/Day views with API) due to DUPLICATE ROUTE BUG in App.jsx.

integration_issues.issue: DUPLICATE ROUTE BUG: App.jsx has '/calendar' route defined twice (line 290 and line 309). First route uses MeetingCalendarPage (local storage, simple UI), second route defines CalendarPage (full API integration with Month/Week/Day views) which is NEVER reached. The advanced CalendarPage.jsx component is unused.
MeetingCalendarPage uses local meetingService instead of /api/calendar/events backend API. The CalendarPage.jsx (which properly integrates with backend) is not being rendered due to route conflict.

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/calendar/events returns events for user (200)
Backend: POST /api/calendar/events creates event with invitees and sends email invitation
Backend: GET /api/calendar/upcoming returns upcoming events for dashboard widget
Backend: Video call link auto-generated when video_call=true
Frontend: Calendar link visible in sidebar navigation
Frontend: Month view calendar grid displays correctly
Frontend: Schedule Meeting button opens modal
Frontend: Schedule modal has Title, Date, Time, Attendees, Description fields
failed_tests: Frontend: Month/Week/Day view switcher NOT visible - CalendarPage.jsx not being used due to route conflict
Frontend: 'New Event' button NOT visible - MeetingCalendarPage shows 'Schedule Meeting' instead
Frontend: Color-coded categories NOT visible - CalendarPage feature not rendered
Frontend: Recurring meetings UI NOT visible - CalendarPage feature not rendered
action_items: CRITICAL: Fix duplicate '/calendar' route in App.jsx - Remove line 290 OR change CalendarPage route to different path like '/calendar-v2'. Currently line 290 (MeetingCalendarPage) takes precedence, so CalendarPage is never rendered.

RECOMMENDATION: If you want to use CalendarPage.jsx (which has Month/Week/Day views and integrates with /api/calendar/events), either: (a) Remove the MeetingCalendarPage route at line 290, OR (b) Rename the CalendarPage route to a different path
Current state: MeetingCalendarPage works but uses local storage. CalendarPage with full API integration is implemented but unreachable.
